description: The line plot illustrates the MRR@10 performance of different DPR (Dense Passage Retrieval) variants as a function of the number of queries used during inference (S), ranging from 1 to 10. The x-axis, labeled “Number of queries used during inference (S),” is linearly scaled with integer tick marks at 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10. The y-axis, labeled “MRR@10,” is linearly scaled from 33.0 to 36.5, with major tick marks every 0.5 units. Six distinct lines represent different DPR configurations: “DPR w/o query” (black solid line) remains flat at approximately 34.8 across all S values; “DPR w/ gold” (yellow line with circle markers) starts near 33.0 at S=1 and rises steadily to about 35.0 at S=10; “DPR w/ bottom-1” (green line with circle markers) begins at 33.0, jumps sharply to 35.5 at S=2, and continues increasing to 36.5 at S=10; “DPR w/ random” (blue line with circle markers) starts at 34.8, rises slightly to 35.7 at S=2, then plateaus around 35.7–35.8; “DPR w/ curriculum” (red line with circle markers) begins at 35.6, rises to 36.0 at S=6, then stabilizes near 36.0; and “DPR w/ bottom-1” (purple line with circle markers) starts at 34.9, dips slightly to 34.8, and remains relatively flat around 34.8–34.9. Two horizontal dashed reference lines are shown: a red dashed line near 35.6 and a green dashed line near 34.8, likely indicating baseline or target performance levels.
